pre_discovery_note: pairfam was identified through search and summary metadata before this freeze; this is NOT preregistration of source discovery or prior published findings. This freezes the subsequent eligibility and access audit only.
classification: DOCUMENTARY, no microdata runs unless lawfully retrieved

A.question: Does the German pairfam 14-wave survey provide independent time-indexed partner-level observations of formation, attrition and breakup that HCMST lacks, and can the exact authorized research files be retrieved here?
A.estimand: source eligibility and accessibility; not a causal romantic-choice effect
A.outcome: documented partner and episode data, not couple formation effects estimated in this cycle

hypotheses: H1 pairfam provides repeated multi-actor partner and relationship spells with dating partner reports
H0 partner respondent data cannot be linked for longitudinal modeling or measures are too restricted
H_alt availability varies by wave, cohort, selection and permission; HCMST remains adequate for simpler survival analysis
B.prior_art: already inspected HCMST 2017–22; pairfam named but source documentation not yet read in depth

C.decision_rule: Report official dataset structure, release, terms, and exact access outcome. Admit N78 as documentary cycle only if a genuinely new class of source observation is documented compared with HCMST and all A–J are completed; otherwise planning-only. No scientific validation without data.
falsifiers: No partner interviews, linkage or episode history in official codebook
Access conditions prevent lawful analysis in this environment
strong_controls: HCMST 2017–22: repeated individual records, no direct partner response
NLSY97: longitudinal individual relationship histories, no cross-respondent partner surveys unless codebook shows otherwise
Negative control: exposure of unchosen app candidates should remain absent in pairfam
C.selection_exposure: adaptive source discovery, exploratory, no reserved human outcome holdout

D.instrumentation: Official GESIS/pairfam project documentation and independent registration/licensing; attempt authorized download without bypass; exact source links, failures and file hashes if acquired

E: One source-gate evaluation only, not synthetic simulation
F: Adversarial check: multi-actor interviewed partners are selected, surviving pair only; retrospective histories and attrition; no swipe universe; German cohorts and external validity
G: No external confirmation of ESBM mechanism in absence of human records and strong baselines
H: Qualitative prior update only; no numeric Bayes updates from metadata
I: 0/3 or documentary eligibility; CT2 7 -> 7 unless new actual discriminating human data are processed; no N1/2/3 by source listing
J: STOP_R5 if no usable microdata, retain remaining authorizations; do not open N79 without a distinct discriminating instrument
access_ethics: No unauthorized redistribution, no inference about identifiable individuals, no bypass of registration or institutional restrictions
precommit_requirements: GitHub commit before documentation inspection; reference source V14 and access terms; archive post-audit sources and priors
hash_purpose: Repository commit is time-order provenance, NOT cryptographic hash of remote dataset
